item.title: The 500 colleges where former students aren't repaying their loans, and why
item.description: Federal data shows many borrowers who aren't paying their loans went to private, for-profit colleges — schools that often market to low-income students and rely on federal financial aid for revenue.

item.title: The Fed is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in 3 years
item.description: The Fed is widely expected to raise its benchmark interest rate to combat stubborn inflation. That could make it more expensive to borrow money to buy a car or carry a balance on a credit card.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025 — but safety net cuts could erase gains
item.description: An annual report from the Census Bureau shows the average family made more money in 2025 than the year before, while the official poverty rate declined. Health care coverage was little changed from 2024.

item.title: A new tax incentive could lead to more films being made in the U.S. rather than abroad
item.description: President Trump and Congress are weighing in on potential federal tax incentives for film production. It's hoped the tax credit would keep production of films and TV in the U.S. rather than overseas.
